en.hubeali:
And by this chain, said, 
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘

What is the least of what would suffice me, from the Praise?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should be saying, 
‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is Exalted, so Subdues, and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is King, so is Able, and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is within, so is Knowing, and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Causes the living to die and Revives the dead, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is Able upon everything’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The least for thanksgiving is to say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah who is High, so all things are subdued before Him, all praise belongs to Allah who owns all things, so He provides sustenance to all of them, all praise belongs to Allah who is inside, so He has the news of all things, all praise belongs to Allah who causes the living to die, gives life to the dead and has power over all things.’”
